title: Amazon Prime Video takes on TikTok with short-form news clips | TechCrunch
summary: Based on findings from Pew Research , these younger news consumers want short-form news content that “feels organic, not over-produced.” Prime Video is not the first streamer to add short-form clips to its content lineup.
